title: A Quiet Place
tagline: Don't make a sound. Not even when you chew.
about: A family lives in silence on a farm to avoid blind creatures that hunt by sound.
cue: Serve the mains when the family eats dinner off leaves instead of plates.
faces: “I love you. I've always loved you.”
